m: शट् (prob. artificial) cl. 1. P. शटति, to be sick; to divide, pierce; to be dissolved; to be weary or dejected; to go, Dhātup. ix, 12 : cl. 10. Ā. शाटयते, Dhātup. xxxiii, 18 v.l. for √ 1. शठ्.
a: शट् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (शटति) 1 To be sick. --2 To divide, separate. --3 To be dissolved. --4 To be weary or dejected. --5 To go. {vII.v} {c10c} A. (शाटयते) To praise, flatter.
